content.rationale: Verification is where the assembled file meets its checker: run `quint typecheck specs/markers/check.qnt && quint verify specs/markers/check.qnt --main=markers --invariant=TypeOK,RevertsShaped,TailUndone --max-steps=10` — grammar plus types first, then bounded-exhaustive invariants over all traces to the bound. What an undone marker records is only visible in the marker list the assembled step builds, so the two invariants decide the undoing leg's use of its prerequisites there: RevertsShaped pins what an undo records (D8a's whole-operation inverse — no reverts while a marker is applied and, once it is undone, one revert per kept entry, the same shape for every kind) and TailUndone pins the linear history (kpptprql — applied markers carry no reverts, the markers in the undone tail carry them). Run it at placement and whenever any section changes (verify needs a JDK for its Apalache backend; typecheck does not).
